calls.reasoning: Measurement is a single CoinGecko 00:00 UTC snapshot at 2026-09-18T00:00Z (convention independently verified by all four runs), 10.85 days out, from spot ~$105.0 — NO requires a net -4.88% log move, so status quo resolves YES. Best-matched instrument is Deribit SOL_USDC-18SEP26 (expiry 8h after the instant): zero basis to spot, near-symmetric smile, put-spread digital putting P(below $100) at ~0.30. I shade that down: implied 53% sits under 10-day realized ~56% and the book is thin (0.7/0.9 at K=95), and the Sep 16 FOMC lands ~30 hours before the close with no time to mean-revert. Using sigma ~58% annualized plus one event day gives horizon SD ~11.0%, d2=0.39, YES ~0.65, plus ~2 pts for fat tails at a sub-0.5-sigma threshold. Driftless is the honest call: -49% YoY and +43% 30-day cancel, and the forward carries no carry signal. The $99.97 close on Sep 1 confirms the level is genuinely live, not a distant strike.
calls.reconciliation: Four disputes were factual. (a) ETF flows: Run 1 called the '$153.87M strongest week since Oct 2025' figure unreliable against Farside's $4.9M for the week ending Sep 4; but Run 1's own '$142.7M prior five sessions' makes the two mutually consistent as consecutive weeks — a strong week already in the price followed by ~97% deceleration. Both stand; the net ETF signal is neutral-to-slightly-negative, so I removed the bullish tilt Runs 2/3 took from it. (b) FOMC direction (58-66% hike per Runs 2/3 vs ~65% hold per Run 4) could NOT be settled from the dossiers; I let it carry its uncertainty and price it as a symmetric one-day variance bump ~30 hours before the close, not a directional prior. (c) Three runs failed to retrieve an options surface and one did; non-retrieval is not counter-evidence, and Run 1's figures are internally coherent (smile minimum at the forward, zero basis, put-spread digital 0.30 matching N(d2)=0.686), so I credit it as the best-matched instrument while carrying its thin-book caveat. (d) Spot settles at ~$105.0 on four concordant API pulls at 03:39-03:55Z; Run 2's $106.4x are venue quotes and its $106.49 is the Sep 6 close. Unanimous and accepted: the 00:00 UTC D+1 close convention, the single-close (not touch) semantics, and that no contract matching threshold + deadline + resolution source exists on Kalshi, Polymarket, or Manifold — the near-misses are corroboration only. Pure-judgment calls I take rather than split: driftless (the -49% YoY and +43% 30-day drifts cancel and the forward shows zero basis), and vol ~58% annualized between implied and 10-day realized rather than the trend-inflated 18-day 65%. I carry Run 4's de-trended reference-class base rate (~0.69) forward as the anchor and land at 0.67, below the raw options digital because implied vol sits under realized on a thin book.
